shops.name: Bloom House Colombo
shops.tagLine: Artisan Bouquets & Luxury Preserved Floral Boxes
shops.description: Colombo's premier floral studio crafting breathtaking bouquets, boxed fresh Ecuadorian roses, and everlasting dried flower arrangements for life's most unforgettable occasions.

shops.name: Spa Ceylon Luxury Ayurveda
shops.tagLine: Royal Wellness & Ceylon Botanical Spa Rituals
shops.description: World-renowned Ceylon luxury ayurveda bath, body, skincare and wellness collections, packaged with regal elegance and pure royal botanical ingredients.

shops.name: Mimosa Studio
shops.tagLine: Modern Curated Gift Boxes & Celebration Essentials
shops.description: Thoughtfully themed gift hampers featuring locally crafted goodies, premium teas, scented candles, and customized keepsakes packaged in signature reusable pine and matte boxes.

shops.name: Butter Boutique
shops.tagLine: Decadent Artisan Cakes, Gourmet Cookies & Sweet Treats
shops.description: Famous for decadent layered cakes, tres leches, handmade artisan gelato, gourmet brownies and show-stopping celebration treats baked with pure French butter and real chocolate.

shops.name: Urban Island
shops.tagLine: Contemporary Tropical Lifestyle, Ceramic Ware & Homeware
shops.description: Celebrating modern tropical Sri Lankan design through handwoven textiles, handcrafted stoneware ceramics, scented soy candles, and artisan lifestyle decor.

shops.name: Barefoot Ceylon
shops.tagLine: Iconic Handloom Wonders, Books, Toys & Island Living
shops.description: A legendary Sri Lankan institution created by Barbara Sansoni. Vibrant hand-dyed cotton handlooms, handcrafted soft toys, bespoke notebooks, and coffee table Ceylon art books.

shops.name: The Scent Bar Colombo
shops.tagLine: Bespoke Perfumery, Scented Mist & Reed Diffusers
shops.description: Crafting customized signature fragrances, luxury soy wax candles, and oriental reed diffusers inspired by tropical Ceylon spices, vanilla orchids and ocean breezes.

shops.name: Aurelia Fine Jewellery
shops.tagLine: Minimalist 18k Gold Plated, Sterling Silver & Ceylon Sapphires
shops.description: Timeless everyday fine jewelry featuring ethically sourced Ceylon sapphires, dainty 18k gold vermeil pendants, stackable rings, and customized birthstone necklaces.

shops.name: Green Thumb Plant Studio
shops.tagLine: Exotic Indoor Botanicals, Bonsai & Handcrafted Planters
shops.description: Lush potted monsteras, air-purifying snake plants, succulent terrariums in handmade terracotta and ceramic vessels that bring peaceful green life to any room.

shops.name: Papyrus Artisan Stationery
shops.tagLine: Handmade Deckled Paper, Leather Journals & Wax Seal Kits
shops.description: Preserving the romantic art of letter writing with recycled handmade elephant dung paper, gilded calligraphy sets, vintage wax stamps, and customized journals.

shops.name: Teaeli Artisan Teas
shops.tagLine: Single Origin Ceylon Designer Tea Blends & Tea Gift Chests
shops.description: Sri Lanka's first designer tea blender, crafting playful, decadent tea infusions like Chocolate Truffle, Mint Earl Grey, and Rose Berry in luxury collectible caddies.

shops.name: The Chocolate Factory Colombo
shops.tagLine: Handmade Single Estate Dark Cocoa Truffles & Pralines
shops.description: Small-batch bean-to-bar chocolatier producing velvety bonbons infused with Ceylon cinnamon, salted caramel, cashew crunch, and wild passion fruit.

shops.name: Negombo Clay & Pottery House
shops.tagLine: Earthy Hand-thrown Ceramic Mugs, Planters & Dinnerware
shops.description: Cozy coastal pottery studio crafting minimal matte terracotta coffee mugs, glazed noodle bowls, and aroma burners made by local master potters.

shops.name: Kandy Craft & Silks
shops.tagLine: Traditional Kandyan Brass, Handwoven Batik Silks & Woodcarvings
shops.description: Heritage craftsmen cooperative from the sacred hills of Kandy delivering hand-drawn silk batiks, embossed brass platters, and polished ebony decorative keepsakes.

products.name: Velvet Crimson Rose & Baby's Breath Bouquet
products.description: 24 handpicked long-stem red roses wrapped in premium waterproof matte Korean paper and tied with a luxury satin ribbon. Includes complimentary handwritten calligraphed card.

products.name: Pastel Dream Preserved Everlasting Floral Dome
products.description: A magical glass bell jar housing 100% real preserved hydrangea and peony blooms that last 3+ years without watering. Features subtle warm fairy lights embedded inside.

products.name: Sunflower Sunshine Hand-Tied Posy
products.description: Bright golden sunflowers paired with chamomile flowers and eucalyptus leaves. Guaranteed to bring instant joy and bright energy to any graduate or best friend.

products.name: De-Stress Luxury Wellness Gift Box
products.description: Infused with calming Frankincense, pure Kaffir Lime and soothing Sandalwood. Contains Relaxing Body Cleanser, Body Massage Oil, Calming Mist, and Peace Soothing Balm.

products.name: Ceylon Tea & Aloe Gentle Face Care Set
products.description: Hydrating Ceylon Green Tea clarifying face wash, refreshing floral facial toning mist, and ultra-light soothing aloe vera moisture gel for radiant tropical skin.

products.name: The 'Sweet Hug' Thoughtful Care Package
products.description: Includes an artisan scented soy candle (Vanilla Berry), gourmet chocolate fudge brownie cookies, a cozy ceramic mug, and a customized personalized greeting card in a ribboned gift box.

products.name: Gentleman's Executive Coffee & Leather Box
products.description: Features premium single-origin Ceylon roasted Arabica coffee beans, a stainless steel french press, genuine top-grain leather card holder, and dark single-estate chocolate thins.

products.name: Signature Tres Leches Celebration Cake (1kg)
products.description: Colossal sponge soaked in three rich creams, topped with whipped chantilly and fresh strawberries. Colombo's most celebrated birthday and anniversary centerpiece dessert.

products.name: Dainty Ceylon Blue Sapphire Solitaire Necklace
products.description: A brilliant round-cut 4mm natural Ceylon blue sapphire bezel-set on a shimmering 16-18 inch adjustable 18k gold-plated 925 sterling silver cable chain. Packaged in a velvet keepsake box.

products.name: Personalized Initial Letter Disc Bracelet
products.description: Custom hand-stamped initial disc on a dainty 14k gold-filled chain. Pick any uppercase letter to create an intimate keepsake she can wear everyday.

products.name: Handcrafted Single-Origin Praline Collection (16-Piece)
products.description: Artisan chocolate gems hand-painted with colored cocoa butter. Flavors include Ceylon Cinnamon Ganache, Passionfruit Gelee, Kandy Salted Caramel, and Pistachio Cream.

products.name: Ceylon Vanilla & Wild Fig Luxury Scented Candle
products.description: 250g natural coconut-soy wax candle with double cotton wick. Features top notes of fresh black fig, heart of spicy vanilla bean, and warm sandalwood base. 55-hour burn time.

products.name: Handwoven Sunset Orange Cotton Tote Bag
products.description: Heavy-duty 100% Sri Lankan handloom cotton tote featuring iconic Barbara Sansoni bright geometric stripes, sturdy shoulder straps, and interior zip pocket.

products.name: Artisan Dessert Tea Trio Gift Chest
products.description: Three collectible matte tins featuring 'Choc Mint Truffle', 'Almond Vanilla Rooibos', and 'Strawberries & Champagne Green Tea' presented in an embossed wooden slider box with golden mesh tea infuser.

products.name: Miniature Geometric Succulent & Crystal Terrarium
products.description: Hexagonal glass and brass terrarium featuring 3 hardy assorted succulents, raw rose quartz crystal, white river pebbles and charcoal filtration layer.

products.name: Speckled White Wheel-Thrown Coffee Mug
products.description: Chunky ergonomic ceramic mug with comfortable thumb rest, handcrafted from local Negombo river clay with white speckled matte glaze.
